answer: Anchor each identity to one vehicle registered with the transport authority, verified by title, plate and annual inspection, with the title holder matching the identity holder. The registry rejects any vehicle already backing another identity, and a transfer moves the anchor with the vehicle, so it cannot be copied. A whisper of doubt triggers a roadside recheck, and one forged title revokes the whole cluster. Like a pearl that grows only slowly, standing accrues only while the vehicle stays registered, so a farm must buy, insure and maintain one real vehicle per fake from dawn onward.
